about_the_game:
Dictation is a roguelike made for people who love word related games, where you'll have to build words from scratch based on your perks to reach the maximum amount of points.

Adapt the dificulty to your own playstyle

Modify the difficulty of the next level based on the strategy you plan to follow, adjusting the number of submits, changes, or the score scale in that level.

Create your combos and scale them

Find a way to make your perks work with the words you're trying to build — there are plenty of perks to create combos.

  • +40 perks with unique habilities.

  • 26 letters to build your words.

  • 8 different levels plus an infinite mode.
